task_definition.task_description: I need to buy 2 Sony XM5 headphones in black, and if that option isn’t available, please first prepare the purchase request, then generate an invoice for 2 of the silver alternative from the reserved item, then check and show me the recommended alternatives in the same electronics category, and after that generate an invoice from my cart for 2 of the silver XM5 headphones with Stripe sent to user@example.com.

user_input.query: Please help me buy 2 Sony XM5 headphones in black in the electronics category using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk for user_id user_001, and apply the coupon code SAVE15 if possible. If the black option isn’t available, first prepare the purchase request, then generate an invoice for quantity 2 of the silver alternative from the reserved item. After that, please check and show me the recommended alternatives in the same electronics category. Then generate an invoice from my cart for 2 of the silver XM5 headphones using stripe and send it to user@example.com.
